label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled param flows through URL decode into base.resolve(once).normalize(), then validated with startsWith(base). While normalize() reduces some traversal risks, the startsWith check is insufficient against symlink attacks—if /data is a symlink, resolved path could point outside /data namespace. Also, multiple consecutive .. sequences combined with encode/decode variations could bypass the prefix check. Resolved sink value depends on attacker input reaching Files.readAllBytes(resolved).

evidence.note: User param flows to resolved path via base.resolve(once).normalize(), then checked with startsWith(base) before reading file
